Name: Safe Lightning Updated
Author: rokugin
Description:
[u][size=5]Install[/size][/u]
[size=3]1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
2. Unzip the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.
(optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0.[/size]

[size=5][u]About[/u][/size]
[size=3]Based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2039]Safe Lightning[/url] by CatCattyCat and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11857]Safe Lightning Redux[/url] by Shockah.
By default, stops lightning from destroying crops and trees. Stops lightning strikes and thunder sounds, however if you really want those back there's a config option to turn them back on while still retaining the safety functionality. Never really liked the thunder sounds in game and wanted to make something for people with astraphobia.[/size]

[size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size]
[size=3]Works in singleplayer. Works if the host has it installed in multiplayer.

[url=https://github.com/rokugin/SafeLightningUpdated]Source[/url][/size]
